description: Fetch BrowserStack self-healed selectors plus the test source code for the run. Provide exactly one of `sessionId` (single Automate / App-Automate session) or `buildUuid` (full self-healing report for a build). Pass the returned locator pairs to `prepareSelfHealingPlan` to plan edits. Requires a session id. listSessions lists them for a build; if you do not have the build either, getBuildId or listBuildId resolves one from a project and build name.

buildUuid.description: Build UUID. Fetches the build's self-healing report.

sessionId.description: Session ID. Mutually exclusive with buildUuid.

sessionType.description: Used with sessionId. Defaults to automate.

name: fetchSelfHealedSelectors
